claims.label: ADN humain et mouche

claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Conduits et lieux sombres
claims.excerpt: These creatures like to hang around in small dark places such as air ducts.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Origine dans les expériences sur les amblypyges
claims.excerpt: These giant spiders are a result of Alex Wesker's experiments on ordinary whip spiders.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Dents acérées et attaque au cou
claims.excerpt: These creatures are fairly slow, but they can easily corner you and attempt to rip at your neck with their razor sharp teeth.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Locomotion quadrupède
claims.excerpt: This variant of the Molded, as its namesake implies, crawls around on all fours.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Projection de bile corrosive
claims.excerpt: This vile creatures has the ability to puke up corrosive bile from its gut, and spew if forth surprisingly far.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Araignées pâles et obstacles
claims.excerpt: They are albino-looking spiders, roughly the same size as a tarantula.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Nid générateur de nuées
claims.excerpt: The nest will continually spawn these insects until it is destroyed, so your focus should always be to get rid of the source rather than waste ammunition on the insects themselves.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Vol et attaque
claims.excerpt: These large flying insects will buzz around and attack you, making them extremely irritating and potentially a waste of ammunition depending on your aim.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Forme ailée et force destructrice
claims.excerpt: When she takes this shape she has the appearance of a giant winged demon, capable of flight and enough strength to smash through stone walls.
claims.phase: Forme mutée seulement ; ne pas attribuer les ailes à la forme humaine.

claims.label: Existence incertaine de la créature
claims.excerpt: It is never stated whether this creature actually exists or if it is all just an illusion created by Donna Beneviento and her hallucinogenic abilities.
claims.phase: Séquence Beneviento ; existence physique non établie par cette source.

claims.label: Armement et saut
claims.excerpt: They wield giant weapons and can jump great distances, and have the ability to summon other creatures to assist in the fight against you.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Attributs de poisson et nage rapide
claims.excerpt: When he takes this shape he essentially develops certain attributes of a giant fish, allowing him to swim at great speeds.
claims.phase: Forme mutée seulement ; manteau et corps humain exclus.

claims.label: Armure métallique de la forme mutée
claims.excerpt: When he takes this shape, he resembles a giant multi-armed cyborg with his mutated body concealed by various metal objects to form a layer of protective armour.
claims.phase: Forme mutée seulement ; ne pas reprendre ce corps pour Heisenberg humain.

claims.label: Outils agricoles comme armes
claims.excerpt: The villagers are capable of wielding many different types of weapons, primarily fashioning themselves with various agricultural tools to use as instruments in which to attack you.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Tronçonneuse
claims.excerpt: This is a stronger variant of a villager who wields a deadly chainsaw.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Habitants de Wrenwood infectés
claims.excerpt: These zombies are the poor residents of Wrenwood that were infected with a new mutated strain of the T-Virus by Victor Gideon.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Faiblesse aux UV
claims.excerpt: However UV light is this monster's weakness, so entering a room with a light source will damage her and force her to retreat back into the darkness.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Personnel du centre infecté
claims.excerpt: These zombies are the poor staff members of the Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center that were infected with a new mutated strain of the T-Virus by Victor Gideon.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Visage bandé et perception sonore

claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Variante renforcée du personnel

claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Deux sujets frères
claims.excerpt: There are two Chunks you encounter and they are in fact brothers.
claims.phase: Groupe de publication Chunk ; pas une attribution indépendante de chaque apparence aux deux frères.

claims.label: Progéniture de Titan Spinner
claims.excerpt: These small spiders (although still enormous compared to regular everyday spiders) are the offspring of the Titan Spinner.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Déplacement sur les murs
claims.excerpt: Despite its size it is extremely fast and capable of crawling across walls and squeezing its bulky body into buildings.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Armes improvisées
claims.excerpt: They will attack you with not only their bare hands, but anything they can get their hands on that could be used as a weapon including makeshift spears and various forms of debris.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Armure, armes et grenades
claims.excerpt: These zombies can be especially tough to put down as not only do they come equipped with weapons and grenades, but they wear thick body armor that usually means you have to aim carefully for headshots or other exposed areas of the body.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Tronçonneuse de la variante résistante
claims.excerpt: This is a stronger variant of the Raccoon City zombie that is not only more resistant to damage, but comes wielding a deadly chainsaw.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Mutation canine
claims.excerpt: These mutant dogs are essentially a new form of the original Cerberus bio-weapon.
claims.phase: Incarnation et forme de la fiche ; seule la propriété citée est documentée.

claims.label: Identité HUNK non confirmée
claims.excerpt: It is theorised that this commander is in fact the infamous HUNK who has undergone many missions, including the retrieval of the G-Virus from William Birkin prior to the original outbreak in Raccoon City.
claims.phase: Identité du Commandant : théorie explicitement présentée comme telle, pas un alias HUNK certifié.

claims.label: Tronçonneuse de Mia infectée
claims.excerpt: She attacks you with a chainsaw, yeah, but as a visual design she's just a lady.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 7 (2017), forme humaine/infectée citée ; commentaire secondaire, pas une capture primaire.

claims.label: Traque de Jack humain
claims.excerpt: For the first part of the game, in addition to being that aforementioned psychological horror, Jack is also the equivalent to, again, Mr. X or Nemesis as a villain that actively stalks your character and forces you to move quickly or stealthily.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 7 (2017), forme humaine/infectée citée ; commentaire secondaire, pas une capture primaire.

claims.label: Duel à la tronçonneuse
claims.excerpt: Thankfully this is still Resident Evil, so while your first couple of boss fight with Jack is him in his humanoid form (including a chainsaw duel!), his final battle in the base game ends up turning Jack into a writhing mass of black fungal matter around the size of a small car, as he undulates like some sort of giant noodle-centipede within a warehouse.
claims.phase: Duel humain à la tronçonneuse mentionné, sans dimensions exactes ni géométrie de la scie à ciseaux établie.

claims.label: Yeux du corps muté comme points faibles
claims.excerpt: Mutated Jack Baker has a bunch of eyeballs on his body, all of which are, of course, his weak points.
claims.phase: Forme mutée du jeu principal seulement.

claims.label: Swamp Man dans End of Zoe
claims.excerpt: In the 'End of Zoe' DLC, turns out that Jack's remains aren't even dead after three fights -- he has been transformed into the ' Swamp Man ', which is... honestly a bit of an obvious ripoff of DC's Swamp Thing or Marvel's Man-Thing.
claims.phase: End of Zoe, Swamp Man seulement ; comparaison artistique de l’auteur conservée comme commentaire.

claims.label: Contrôle des insectes
claims.excerpt: She is at least a bit more cooler than jack, because instead of relying on chainsaws and whatnot she also controls the insects in the area.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 7 (2017), forme humaine/infectée citée ; commentaire secondaire, pas une capture primaire.

claims.label: Membres allongés et escalade
claims.excerpt: Her arms and legs have elongated so much and she crawls around walls and ceilings like a spider, and it's so unsettling to see an otherwise still-humanoid anatomy.
claims.phase: Marguerite mutée, pas la forme humaine.

claims.label: Pièges de Lucas humain
claims.excerpt: In the base game, Lucas doesn't even fight you, but relies on a long deathtrap maze to bamboozle his 'prey'.
claims.phase: Lucas humain, jeu principal ; négation du combat direct dans ce contexte seulement.

claims.label: Bouche à la main gauche
claims.excerpt: The only real interesting thing is the huge mouth on his left hand, but ultimately if I can call one design 'a generic Resident Evil monster', this would be it.
claims.phase: Lucas muté, DLC Not a Hero ; commentaire d’apparence, pas un répertoire de gestes.

claims.label: Apparence de petite fille
claims.excerpt: Eveline has two humanoid forms, though the one she wants us to see is the shape of a little girl.
claims.phase: Apparence enfant d’Eveline ; ne pas appliquer à son corps final.

claims.label: Visage humain dans la forme finale
claims.excerpt: She's also got her screaming human face in the middle of it.
claims.phase: Dernier combat, masse fongique finale d’Eveline ; le contexte est conservé dans la citation associée.

claims.label: Mutation du dernier combat
claims.excerpt: In her final boss encounter has her transform into a giant flesh-glob. Mycelium-blob?
claims.phase: Dernier combat, forme finale seulement.

claims.label: Mycélium blanc et visage de crâne
claims.excerpt: WM-002 'Fumer' is covered in fully white mycelia, being fuzzier and with more exposed flesh and a skull-like face.
claims.phase: DLC Not a Hero, WM-002 ; ne pas recolorer les Molded du jeu principal.

claims.label: Origine WM-001
claims.excerpt: The host of the 'WM' is WM-001, Mama Mold... who doesn't really get much context beyond being a bigger, stronger White-Mold Molded.
claims.phase: DLC Not a Hero, Mama Mold WM-001 seulement.

claims.label: Bond et attaque au visage
claims.excerpt: They are mostly summoned by Mama Mold, and scuttle around, and can leap and attack your face like an Alien Facehugger.
claims.phase: Little Crawlers de Mama Mold, DLC Not a Hero ; comparaison au Facehugger secondaire.

claims.label: Sauts et agilité
claims.excerpt: In practice, they're basically just stronger, faster and more bestial zombies, leaping and jumping and generally being far more agile than the shamblers that this franchise is normally associated with.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Armure improvisée et armement des bras
claims.excerpt: The 'Large Lycan' seen on the right are smart enough to cobble together a makeshift set of armour and two arm-mounted... how do you describe those? Masses of planks of wood and jagged scrap metal?
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Locomotion quadrupède
claims.excerpt: They tend to run around on all fours, which actually seems to be intentionally made to look awkward since even with longer arms, the human leg structure really isn't meant to allow one to run on all fours.
claims.phase: Vârcolac commun, pas la variante Alfa.

claims.label: Ailes à la place des bras
claims.excerpt: The Samcă are basically Moroaică with wings instead of arms, but that's kind of oversimplifying things.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Lunettes et hache à engrenage
claims.excerpt: These guys, the Haulers, are the lowest of the low, shambling around with a set of steampunk VR goggles that are apparently used to stabilize their neural activity.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Un bras à foreuse
claims.excerpt: Oh, and they have a giant fucking mean-looking industrial drill grafted onto their arms.
claims.phase: Soldat Eins décrit dans la section Eins & Zwei ; un seul bras à foreuse, pas les deux de Zwei.

claims.label: Deux bras à foreuse
claims.excerpt: The Soldat Zwei does feel like an upgrade, because of the very simple fact that both his arms are replaced with drills.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Point faible dorsal
claims.excerpt: The Zwei's weak point is on his back, and he's also swapped the VR goggles for a cool gas mask.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Charge volante aux foreuses
claims.excerpt: This guy's hammerhead-shark-like head looks like it's grafted out of broken metal pieces, but somehow it allows the Soldat Jet to fly around and charge at you with its drills.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Armure à détruire avant exposition du réacteur
claims.excerpt: He's slower, but you have to shoot off all his armour before his reactor core is exposed.
claims.phase: Soldat Panzer ; portée limitée à la phrase de cette section.

claims.label: Les trois sœurs sont des nuées de mouches
claims.excerpt: But then come the revelation that the three daughters weren't exactly human, or reanimated corpses, but rather, well... a literal mass of Cadou parasites that take the form of hundreds of blowflies, and, when combined with the Mold, ends up re-merging together into the form of their humanoid hosts.
claims.phase: Propriété collective des trois filles nommées Bela, Cassandra et Daniela ; aucune couleur ou morphologie individuelle déduite.

claims.label: Les trois sœurs sont des nuées de mouches
claims.excerpt: But then come the revelation that the three daughters weren't exactly human, or reanimated corpses, but rather, well... a literal mass of Cadou parasites that take the form of hundreds of blowflies, and, when combined with the Mold, ends up re-merging together into the form of their humanoid hosts.
claims.phase: Propriété collective des trois filles nommées Bela, Cassandra et Daniela ; aucune couleur ou morphologie individuelle déduite.

claims.phase: Propriété collective des trois filles nommées Bela, Cassandra et Daniela ; aucune couleur ou morphologie individuelle déduite.

claims.label: Barbe et marteau à pointes
claims.excerpt: Sort of a recurring miniboss, Uriaș (Romanian for 'giant') is... a gigantic Lycan with a badass mass of beard and a big-ass spiky hammer.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Masque et tentacules
claims.excerpt: Uriaș Străjer ("Sentinel Giant") has a big fuck-off mace with pretty cool spikes, he wears a wolf mask and has more prominent parasite tentacles growing out of him.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Moteur et rotor du haut du corps
claims.excerpt: It's hard to realize what's going on here, but Heisenberg has replaced Sturm ("storm" in German) entire upper half of this Soldat's body with a motherfucking airplane engine, complete with a spinning rotor.
claims.phase: Resident Evil Village (2021), forme nommée dans le commentaire ; aucune taille physique certifiée.

claims.label: Griffes extensibles
claims.excerpt: This image doesn't show it, but in addition to being a giant that's easily twice the size of Ethan, she's also able to extend her fingers into massive, tapering claws like Marvel's Lady Deathstrike.
claims.phase: Alcina humaine ; comparaison relative du commentaire, pas de taille métrique certifiée.

claims.label: Contrôle des poupées via le Cadou
claims.excerpt: Again, while the puppet dolls actually do move around even outside of hallucinations, turns out that Donna is mentally controlling them because she put parts of her Cadou parasite within them.
claims.phase: Donna et Angie, contrôle des poupées ; aucune forme géante imaginée.

claims.label: Apparence sous le manteau
claims.excerpt: The third of the Four Lords is Salvatore Moreau, a hunchbacked simpleton that seemed to draw on the trope of horror villains like Igor, though his name also is a nod on the classic story Island of Doctor Moreau , which features animal-human hybrids.
claims.phase: Moreau sous le manteau, description extérieure du commentaire seulement.

claims.label: Kystes exposés
claims.excerpt: It's not a hunchback, Moreau is just a mass of pretty nasty-looking cysts, pustules and tumours.
claims.phase: Moreau après retrait du manteau ; ne pas confondre avec la forme pisciforme du boss.

claims.label: Lévitation du métal
claims.excerpt: As in, his first introduction has him levitate a mass of scrap metal and encase Ethan in it, and later on he casually just uses magnetism superpowers to create ladders that float in the air and create a massive steampunk hammer with gears and rusty engine parts he has lying around.
claims.phase: Heisenberg humain, capacités décrites par le commentaire ; forme mutée exclue.

claims.label: Tête bovine comme couverture
claims.excerpt: Taking the 'Ganado' epithet rather literally, these Brutes walk around with giant cow heads covering their heads.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.

claims.label: Colonne allongée et parties arthropodes
claims.excerpt: I don't know how many times I can repeat this, but we keep all of the important parts of the design -- the fact that his legs still look human, that his spine has turned into a fucking centipede, and that the upper body is a combination of his human torso and head, as well as a bunch of giant bug-parts.
claims.phase: Première mutation, jambes humaines encore présentes ; ne pas attribuer à la seconde mutation détachée.

claims.label: Mâchoire et tentacules
claims.excerpt: Del Lago ("From the Lake") gets a much nastier-looking upgrade than I expected, with its salamander maw turning from being rather stretched-out into a monstrous, multi-fanged lamprey.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.

claims.label: Parasite dorsal
claims.excerpt: The artwork here also makes the giant parasite sprouting of Gigante's back a bit more obvious.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.

claims.label: Crocs démesurés
claims.excerpt: The base wolf form now looks hideously mutated, with gigantic fangs and teeth that are way too large for the gums and mouth, making them look unnatural even before they blow apart into gigantic tentacles.
claims.phase: Colmillos commun du remake ; variante Strong Threat non déduite.

claims.label: Yeux cousus et parasite dorsal
claims.excerpt: The over-the-top gigantic Wolverine claws, the torture gimp mask, the exposed Plaga on his back... I guess the fact that the Garrador's eyes are sown shut is a bit more obvious in this incarnation with the higher detailing!
claims.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.

claims.label: Huit pattes et queue recourbée
claims.excerpt: But compared to the four-legged designs of the original RE4, the remake version goes all-in on the Alien Facehugger homage, giving the new Plaga parasites eight legs with some webbing on the most proximal end. In addition, the 'tail'-like body of the Plagas' body doesn't just trail behind it, but now curve upwards and point forwards like a scorpion.
claims.phase: Plaga autonome du remake ; ne pas reprendre les quatre pattes du modèle2005.

claims.label: Tentacules manipulant les armures
claims.excerpt: The remake canonizes some additional explanation that's only told to us in supplementary material in the original game, noting that Plagas (presumably Arana) that have lost their hosts will inhabit these armoured suits, remaining dormant and stretching out their tentacles to manipulate the suit of armour when needed.
claims.phase: Armadura commun ; le terme presumably est une réserve de l’auteur, pas une espèce certifiée.

claims.label: Segments de la queue
claims.excerpt: The upper body looks a bit bulkier and the tail segments have some extra grooves, but that's about it.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.

claims.label: Petite forme humaine vieillie
claims.excerpt: Probably the biggest change is that Ramon Salazar now gets changed from being a literal man-child into a short, stunted old man that wouldn't look out of place among the cast of Resident Evil VIII: Village .
claims.phase: Salazar humain ; forme boss exclue.

claims.label: Fusion dans la forme boss
claims.excerpt: Most of the details are still preserved, but it's a bit more clear that it's a giant flower with Salazar sticking out of it.
claims.phase: Forme boss mutée ; description artistique secondaire seulement.

claims.label: Peau et excroissances
claims.excerpt: Look at that slightly slouched gait, and the rubbery skin, and the lumps on his feet.
claims.phase: Regenerador commun du remake, pas la variante Strong Threat.

claims.label: Longues pointes
claims.excerpt: The spikes for Iron Maiden are far longer than their original version, and I love just how tortured their face looks with the added definition and pixels.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.

claims.label: Vol, invisibilité et attaque en groupe
claims.excerpt: They still go invisible and still swarm and fly around and attack you as giant monstrous bug-men, but the remake actually offers some explanation as to why there's a nest of monstrous cockroach-people in the castle.
claims.phase: Resident Evil 4 remake (2023) ; observation secondaire de la forme citée, pas une capture originale.

claims.label: Visage humain conservé dans la mutation
claims.excerpt: It's a little boring, from a monster design perspective, that he keeps his human face intact.
claims.phase: Bitores Méndez muté, jeu2005 ; jugement artistique explicitement secondaire.
